items.title: Unit 12 · Lesson 1 story
items.storyText:
We're watching a video of our wedding. Can we watch too? OK.

Look. The band is playing music. And I'm dancing with my friends.

Look at Grandma. What's she doing? She's eating the wedding cake.

Look at Mum and Aunt Jane. They're talking.

Look at the little baby. It's you, Milly. Oh, I'm so little. And now I'm ten!

Everyone is singing and talking. And you're sleeping!

items.scene: Dear Hannah, How are you? We're very well. We're getting ready for our summer party. All our family and friends are coming. My brother and I are helping Mum and Dad. We're cooking and cleaning the flat together. Look at this photo. I am with my mum and aunt, Lola. We're choosing party dresses. I like the green and white dress. Look at this. We all like the yellow invitations with purple letters. They're pretty and fun. What do you think? And here, we're choosing party cakes. My brother likes the little cakes. I like the big chocolate cake. I will send photos of the party soon. Love from Bella.

We all like the yellow invitations with purple letters. They're pretty and fun. What do you think? And here, we're choosing party cakes. My brother likes the little cakes. I like the big chocolate cake. I will send photos of the party soon. Love from Bella.
